records.description: For builders who hate posting. Tell Quest in Telegram what you build. It finds people asking for it on X, LinkedIn, Threads and Reddit, writes to them in your voice, and your own Chrome replies, likes and follows from your real accounts. Launch offer: the first run is free, and your first top-up gets up to 2x credits, added automatically.

records.name: DuneQuote
records.tagline: DuneQuote quotation app: WhatsApp quotes with follow-ups
records.description: DuneQuote quotation app for UAE business owners: create quotes in AED with 5% UAE VAT (or no VAT if not registered), in English or English + Arabic, send them on WhatsApp as a link the client accepts on their phone, and follow up in one tap. Prices can be entered before VAT or VAT included. Also available in Saudi Arabia (SAR, 15% VAT), Qatar (QAR), Bahrain (BHD, 10% VAT), Oman (OMR, 5% VAT) and Kuwait (KWD) at dunequote.com/sa/, /qa/, /bh/, /om/ and /kw/.

records.name: Web Submit Pro
records.tagline: Get free backlinks and improve your link profile
records.description: Web Submit Pro is a website promotion tool designed to simplify the process of discovering submission opportunities and link building. Can be useful for website owners, bloggers, developers, small businesses, digital marketers, and SEO beginners looking for additional ways to promote their websites and build an online presence and backlinks. This app won't guarantee backlinks, indexing or better SEO rankings, but can be a useful addition to a broader SEO and link-building strategy.

records.name: Sonex DJ
records.tagline: The music player built for DJs
records.description: Sonex DJ is a music player for DJs. Listen to and organize your library with BPM, Camelot key and waveforms, then sync playlists, hot cues and ratings with Rekordbox, Serato, Traktor, Engine DJ, VirtualDJ and djay. Free plan, no time or track limit.

records.name: GetReelCom
records.tagline: Turn your website into a company video in minutes
records.description: Most AI video tools start with a blank prompt. GetReelCom starts with your website. It reads your site, builds an editable Director's Guide (brand, products, audience, venues, characters) and drafts the script. You approve the still frame of every scene before it becomes video, pick 16:9 or 9:16 and download a ready-to-share company video. Realistic or animated, with the same cast in every scene. First company video free: 40 credits, no card, sign in with Google or Microsoft.

records.name: Thaw: Icebreaker Conversation
records.tagline: Chit Chat & Deep Questions
records.description: Something to say when the conversation stalls. Most icebreaker apps hand you one random question and leave you there. Thaw gives you the whole conversation: a question to start with, the follow-ups to ask once they answer, and a line to change the subject if it goes nowhere. Read it once, put the phone away, and you have the next two minutes covered.

records.name: SwiftBill
records.tagline: GST billing and inventory for small shops in India
records.description: SwiftBill is GST-ready billing and inventory for small shops in India. Scan a barcode, print a tax invoice, and stock updates itself. Track customer dues, remind customers on WhatsApp, and keep billing offline, in English, Hindi or Marathi. Built for kirana stores, pharmacies and small wholesalers. Free beta: works on a phone or a counter PC. GST outputs should be reviewed with your CA before filing.

records.name: Prominentz
records.tagline: Restaurant POS & Kitchen Display for $50/month flat
records.description: Restaurant POS, kitchen display (KDS), QR table ordering, inventory, staff, and online ordering — all in one. Runs on any iPad, Android tablet, or browser. $50/month flat. No contracts. 0% take-rate.

records.name: GoPinKaro
records.tagline: Schedule Pinterest pins in bulk, from your website
records.description: Bulk-schedule up to 200 Pinterest pins from images or a CSV, turn web pages and sitemaps into drafted pins, and publish at best-time slots through the official Pinterest API. Manage up to 100 Pinterest accounts from one login. Free plan, paid from $9 a month. Pinterest only.

records.name: EEATClean
records.tagline: Find outdated or incorrect facts in expert articles
records.description: Consultants, trainers and independent experts use articles to earn buyers’ trust. EEATClean checks article facts against current web sources: dates, versions, figures, prices, statistics, laws, rules, standards, safety advice, procedures, products, services, names and cited sources. Every outdated or incorrect fact comes with a correction and source. You choose what to change and set rechecks every 1, 3 or 6 months. Read-only, no plugin; works with any site with a sitemap.

records.name: $2,800 Visa Gift Card Giveaway Rules and
records.tagline: $2,800 Visa Gift Card Giveaway Rules and Dates
records.description: Read the full rules: who can enter, how the winner is picked, how cards are sent and what to expect. Not affiliated with Visa.

records.name: Domianity
records.tagline: Premium brandable domains with payment plans
records.description: Looking for a domain name? Domianity is a premium domain marketplace with 450,000+ brandable domains, powered by Atom. Secure checkout and payment plans available on most domains.

records.name: Custos
records.tagline: Private, encrypted expense tracker and planner
records.description: Custos is a private expense ledger, schedule, and habit app. Track spending across wallets and 29 currencies, plan bills and tasks, and build routines. Encrypted on your device, offline after setup, and free on the official host. No email sign-in.

records.name: NotesForAll
records.tagline: Still paying for Goodnotes or Notability?
records.description: I built NotesForAll because I believe taking notes shouldn’t require a subscription. * 100% free * No subscriptions * No account required * Built for iPad and Apple Pencil Just a simple, clean note-taking app. I’m constantly improving it and would love your feedback! 👉 https://notesforall.tech/

records.name: Sitaly
records.tagline: Your small business website, written by AI in one minute
records.description: Describe your business in one sentence. Sitaly's AI writes the pages, creates the photos and puts the site online in about a minute. Quotes, invoices, bookings and Google reviews then run from the same app. Built for tradespeople in France. Free to start.

records.name: Mic Drop for Google Meet
records.tagline: Mute on your Mac, and Google Meet finally gets it
records.description: Mic Drop mutes your Mac’s mic in every app. Our new Chrome extension perfects the experience for Google Meet. Mute with your shortcut, AirPods, or Stream Deck, or any other way you like, and everyone on the call sees you’re muted. No more “muted by system” warnings. Everything just magically works. Free, for Mac.

records.name: Zoyi
records.tagline: AI Chatbot for Customer Service & Support
records.description: AI chatbot for customer support & business automation.

records.name: DeclineKit
records.tagline: Open-source failed payment recovery for Stripe
records.description: When a Stripe subscription renewal is declined, DeclineKit emails your customer in your name with a link to a Stripe-hosted card form, then retries the invoice the moment they add a new card. Open source: self-host it free, or use the hosted Cloud.

records.name: Arogyix
records.tagline: Hospital Management System · Pharmacy · Pathology Lab
records.description: All-in-one clinic management platform — appointments, digital prescriptions, pathology lab reports, medicine reminders, and patient timelines for hospitals, clinics, pharmacies, and diagnostic labs.

records.name: Founding Designers
records.tagline: Founding designer jobs, starting with the founders
records.description: A job board for founding designer roles at early-stage startups. Each role opens with the company and the founders behind it, and the job comes last. It updates every week, and an email goes out every two weeks.

records.name: Restock Alert App
records.tagline: iPhone restock alerts for Apple Stores
records.description: Enter a ZIP code to see which nearby US Apple Stores have each iPhone color and storage ready for pickup, free and with no account. Or pick one exact configuration and up to 5 stores, and get an email when it's back.

records.name: Fellmark
records.tagline: A fantasy steampunk survival game where you can dig anywhere
records.description: Fellmark is a fantasy steampunk survival game on smooth voxel ground about two kilometres deep, and all of it can be dug. Mine ore veins, smelt and forge thirteen metals from copper to voidstone, build from the foundations up, survive the cold and the dark, sail the fjords, and in the endgame build automated factories. It's in closed testing on Windows, with online co-op and offline single-player. There's a free demo on itch.io with no time limit.

records.name: ByteAsk Cloud Agents
records.tagline: Find the fix in big codebases. Ship it from Slack.
records.description: ByteAsk gives Claude Code and Codex an index of your whole repo, so they start in the right file. Its Cloud Agent takes bugs from Slack, Jira or the browser, builds and tests in a sandbox, and opens a draft PR. Start with $50 of credit, no card.

records.name: FreshClock: Fridge & Pantry
records.tagline: Eat it before it spoils, and see what you save
records.description: FreshClock shows what to eat before it spoils, and counts the money you save. Add a grocery run in seconds: tap common foods, scan a barcode, or snap your receipt. FreshClock fills in typical expiry dates for the fridge, freezer and pantry, then sorts everything by what needs eating first. FreshClock Plus (optional subscription): read receipts and get recipe ideas every day, look back at every month, and share one pantry and grocery list with your household.

records.name: Your Coucou
records.tagline: Who would notice? A twice-daily check-in if you live alone
records.description: If you live alone, who would notice if something went wrong? Your Coucou is a gentle check-in for an elderly parent, expats, travellers, students, or anyone whose family is far away. Twice a day, a little bird checks in. In the morning, one tap says you're up and okay. Miss it and reminders follow, then your Safe People get a text with your location and spare key details. An SOS button alerts them instantly. In the afternoon, you share how you're feeling. No cameras, no wearables, no tracking.

records.name: Perit Marketplace
records.tagline: Sell your data and RL tasks to frontier AI labs
records.description: Perit Marketplace turns your data and expertise into training work for frontier AI labs. Two ways in: submit data you own (audio, video, code, docs, CAD and more; 29 datasets listed so far), or build RL tasks and benchmarks on our platform using our VMs and model credits. We pitch them to labs, and approved experts scale to hundreds of tasks a week. Built by Perit (YC F26), now past $11M in revenue in 4.5 months.

records.name: Polylane for Security
records.tagline: Catch exploitable vulnerabilities before they ship
records.description: Polylane reviews production-bound pull requests for exploitable security flaws. Findings trace attacker-controlled input to the vulnerable line, with the evidence and suggested fix. Safe candidates are ruled out with a reason. Daily dependency scans find known CVEs, prioritise the most severe and open fix pull requests on active, deployed repositories.

records.name: Remindly
records.tagline: Notes that remind you, on iPhone, iPad, Mac and web
records.description: Remindly is a fast notes app where any note can carry a reminder: one-time, repeating, all-day, or when you arrive somewhere. Capture by typing, voice, scan, or the web clipper. Syncs across iPhone, iPad, Mac and web. Imports your Evernote library.

records.name: GotEmail
records.tagline: Fast, native and smart email for Mac and iPhone
records.description: GotEmail is a native mail app for Mac and iPhone. Gmail, Outlook, iCloud, Yahoo and any IMAP account in one fast inbox, with a Smart Inbox that sorts out what matters, AI drafts, summaries and an assistant that knows your mail, one-click sign-in codes, snooze, send later, undo send, read receipts, labels and smart folders. No ads, no account of ours: your mail goes straight between your device and your provider. One license covers every Mac and the iPhone app.

records.name: Grail
records.tagline: Your meal, in one sentence: the AI food log you talk to
records.description: Grail is an AI food log for iPhone. Say what you ate, the way you'd tell a friend, and it names every item and works out calories, macros and micronutrients. No searching, no barcodes. Your food diary stays private in your own iCloud.

records.name: Denwix SEO Crawler
records.tagline: Free in-browser website crawler for technical SEO
records.description: Denwix SEO Crawler is a free, browser-based website crawler for technical SEO audits. It crawls your whole site and flags broken links, redirects, duplicate or missing titles and meta descriptions, and other on-page issues — a free alternative to desktop crawlers like Screaming Frog and Sitebulb. No install, nothing uploaded, no sign-up for the basics.

records.name: Thirukural: Tamil Wisdom
records.tagline: 2,000-year-old Tamil wisdom, illustrated for today
records.description: All 1,330 couplets of Thiruvalluvar's Thirukkural, the 2,000-year-old Tamil classic on how to live, in Tamil and English. Every Kural has an illustration, a plain-language meaning and a reflection for today's life. Read a Kural a day with an optional reminder, test yourself with quizzes in five modes, bookmark and search, and share a Kural as an image card. Free on iPhone and Android: no ads, no purchases, no account, no analytics.

records.name: Digital Citie
records.tagline: It connects people together in the virtual city
records.description: Digital Citie is a virtual city that connects people together. It’s made for anyone with stressful days at work, or anyone curious about new technology and amazing features. Mugisa, the city’s AI guide, takes you around, so just ask anything about the city. Explore games, video halls, vaults, study rooms, chat rooms, conference rooms and more. Enter the city through the portal on every page of digital-citie.blogspot.com.

records.name: Clipio
records.tagline: Liquid Glass clipboard & file collection for Mac
records.description: Clipio is a free, open-source clipboard and file collection app for macOS. Browse and search copied text, images, links and colors in a lightweight Liquid Glass shelf. Gather files from different folders, then drag them where you need them. Everything stays on your Mac.

records.name: Pudding
records.tagline: A cozy diary for your baby's first foods
records.description: Pudding is a baby food diary for parents starting solids. Log a feeding in a couple of taps: the food, how it went, any reaction, a note and a photo. New foods go through an observation window from your own plan, and gentle reminders help you keep re-offering allergens on the schedule your pediatrician suggests. 70+ illustrated foods, a calendar, a PDF for the pediatrician and a "do not give" sheet for the nanny. No account, no ads.

records.name: Tools Guru
records.tagline: 150 free browser tools. Private, offline, no sign-up
records.description: Tools Guru is 150 free tools in one fast web app: background remover, PDF merge, split and compress, image compressor and resizer, QR codes, EMI, age and BMI calculators, unit converters, birthday and wedding pages, and more. Everything runs in your browser, so your files never leave your device, and most tools keep working offline. No account, no watermarks, no limits. Install it as an app and use it in 31 languages.

records.name: Card & Puzzle
records.tagline: Play card games with friends, right in your browser
records.description: Start a table, send the code, and play Spades, Hearts, Euchre, Crazy 8s, Gin Rummy, Rummy or Trash with friends in any browser. Phones, laptops and the app sit at the same table, and computer players fill any empty seat. Plus solitaire, Mahjong, jigsaws, Minesweeper, Cat Doku and new daily games with leaderboards. Free, no download, no account needed. Free iOS and Android apps too.

records.name: ProMax Display
records.tagline: Full screen that uses your MacBook's whole display
records.description: In full screen, macOS leaves the strip beside the notch black. ProMax Display gives it back: a 14" MacBook Pro goes from a 14.06" screen to the full 14.2". With a rear-view mirror for what's behind the notch, and trackpad gestures for the menu bar and Dock. For MacBooks with a notch or Dynamic Island.

records.name: Adoree
records.tagline: AI relationship assistant that hears both partners privately
records.description: Adoree is an AI relationship assistant for couples. Each partner talks privately by voice or text. Adoree holds both perspectives without taking sides and gives research-backed feedback. Arena helps you work through a specific disagreement. Pulse is a regular check-in across 13 relationship dimensions. Desires captures needs with controls over what is shared, and Growth tracks progress over time. Guidance is grounded in the Gottman Method, Emotionally Focused Therapy, and attachment theory.

records.name: Pagewing
records.tagline: Screen recorder & PDF editor in one Chrome side panel
records.description: Pagewing is a Chrome extension that puts a screen recorder, PDF editor and screenshot tool in one side panel next to the page you're on. Record your screen and camera, then save it or share a link. Annotate, fill in, sign and merge PDFs without uploading them. Capture full-page screenshots, turn a task into a step-by-step guide, and tidy bookmarks and tabs. Also on Firefox. Every tool has a free plan; Premium ($20/mo) and Pro ($30/mo) remove the limits.

records.name: iOS Push Notification Mockup
records.tagline: Free iPhone Lock Screen mockup with iOS 27 Liquid Glass
records.description: Make a realistic iPhone Lock Screen with your own Push Notifications in seconds. Write up to three notifications, pick a real app icon or upload your own, and add a chat avatar. Choose the wallpaper and a Liquid Glass or solid clock. Download a full-resolution PNG, with or without the iPhone frame, including iPhone Duo App Store sizes. Free, no sign-up, no watermark, and your images never leave your browser.

records.name: Wanderjet
records.tagline: Turn focus sessions into flights you take with others
records.description: A focus timer for iPhone where every session is a flight. Pick a real city and work until you land. Choose your seat in a 3D cabin, collect a passport stamp for each country, or board the group flight that leaves every hour and land with everyone else.

records.name: Mathing
records.tagline: A daily 60-second mental math game in your browser
records.description: Mathing is a fast, free daily mental math game. You get 60 seconds to solve as many arithmetic equations (+, −, ×, ÷) as you can. Everyone plays the exact same daily puzzle that resets at midnight, plus an unlimited practice mode to warm up or keep playing anytime. No ads, no accounts, and no app downloads—just open your browser, play in 60 seconds, and share your score.

records.name: Valusaur
records.tagline: Pokémon card scanner and price checker
records.description: Valusaur is a Pokémon card scanner and price checker for iPhone and the web. Scan a card or search by name to see your Pokémon card value from TCGplayer and Cardmarket prices. On valusaur.com you get a free scanner, a price lookup and a list of the most expensive cards. The iPhone app scans many cards in a row, reads cards from 9 regions, including Japan, China and Korea, and follows the value of your collection over time.

records.name: CryptoPaperTrading
records.tagline: Practise crypto futures & options with $10k virtual money
records.description: A free crypto trading simulator. You get $10,000 in virtual USD and a real trading screen on live prices: spot, perpetual futures up to 25x with a live liquidation price, and options on BTC, ETH, SOL and more with Greeks and a strategy builder. Fees, isolated margin and liquidation work like a real exchange, so you learn what wipes out an account before it costs real money. No deposit, no KYC. Not investment advice.

records.name: WhatsMyEmissions
records.tagline: Free Scope 1, 2 and 3 carbon calculator for SMEs, no sign-up
records.description: WhatsMyEmissions is a free, open-access carbon accounting calculator for small and medium-sized enterprises. It follows the GHG Protocol Corporate Standard and covers Scope 1 (fuels, fleet, refrigerants), Scope 2 (location- and market-based) and Scope 3, using published factors from ECCC, UK DESNZ/DEFRA, US EPA, India CEA and the IPCC, with AR5 GWPs. No sign-up needed: without an account, your data stays in your browser. A free account saves inventories and adds the full PDF report.

records.name: Menivor
records.tagline: Paste a link, get a vertical demo reel with captions
records.description: Menivor turns a product link into a vertical, TikTok-ready demo reel. Paste your App Store, Google Play, or website link (or type a topic) and it captures the product, writes a script, adds an AI voiceover and word-by-word captions, then renders three reels with different hooks. New accounts get 3 reels free, no card. After that: one-time credit packs (never expire, failed renders refunded) or monthly plans for regular posting. Built for founders and marketers who need demo content fast.

records.name: BookSparker
records.tagline: Book marketing tools for indie authors, free to start
records.description: BookSparker is a book marketing platform for indie and self-published authors. Deliver reader magnets and ARCs to Kindle, Kobo and Apple Books, add every reader to your mailing list, and book newsletter swaps with authors in your genre. Every plan includes a free author website and universal book links that open the right Amazon store in each country. It works with the mailing list you already have. Free forever plan, paid plans from $15 a month.

records.name: Kallfi
records.tagline: Bring your imagination to life, together
records.description: Your favorite creator, on your time. Discover creators and their AI-powered Souls, then unlock exclusive content on demand. For creators, Kallfi turns imagination into an always-on opportunity to earn—even while they sleep. Our vision: eliminate human time as content creation’s bottleneck, give fans more of what they love, and let creators grow richer by creating beyond the clock.

records.name: PulseVanguarde
records.tagline: Website Tools, Security & SEO — Plus 40% Referral Rewards
records.description: PulseVanguarde is an all-in-one web platform for developers, webmasters, and website owners. Analyze website security, discover potential risks, improve SEO, explore domain information with WHOIS, and access practical web tools in one place. Plus, earn 40% commission on every successful purchase through our referral program. Improve your website, unlock useful insights, and turn your network into an earning opportunity with PulseVanguarde.

records.name: Mezame
records.tagline: A CBT thought diary for when your head spirals
records.description: Mezame is a thought diary built on cognitive behavioral therapy. When a thought spirals (someone doesn't reply and your head decides they're angry), you write it down and take it apart the way a CBT worksheet does: eight questions, about five minutes. Plus a 10-second mood check-in, the twelve thinking traps with plain examples, charts and session prep for your therapist. iPhone, free, no ads, private behind Face ID.

records.name: Kallfi Red
records.tagline: A more daring world for creative expression
records.description: Your favorite creator, on your time—and as daring as your imagination. Discover creators and their AI-powered Souls, then unlock exclusive content on demand, including super NSFW content for adults. Creators can earn even while they sleep. Our vision: eliminate human time as content creation’s bottleneck, give fans more of what they crave, and let creators grow richer beyond the clock.

records.name: Sifter
records.tagline: Build an investing track record recruiters can trust
records.description: Manage your portfolio, run your student fund and build a track record recruiters can trust. Sifter has portfolio analytics, research, pitch decks and team channels, plus a Training Floor where each call and confidence is locked before the result. Recruiters read a candidate’s dated calls and the reasoning behind each one, not just a resume. Students also get a daily-updated board of finance internships, sorted by deadline. Free for students and student funds.

records.name: Runsite
records.tagline: Git push deploys with Postgres and Redis, hosted in Germany
records.description: Connect a GitHub repo and Runsite builds and deploys on every push. Add Postgres, Redis, S3 storage and email from the same dashboard. Everything runs in Germany, with a DPA on every account. Billed hourly in euros. €5 credit to start, no card.

records.name: Shaken UI
records.tagline: Accessible, animated React components you own
records.description: Shaken UI is a component library with 92 accessible, animated React components. Install any of them with one command and the source lands in your project, ready to change. You get the everyday pieces (forms, dialogs, menus, tables, charts, a calendar) and components for AI features: tool call cards, approval prompts, streaming messages and run graphs. Works with Next.js and Vite on Tailwind v4, and with npm, pnpm, Yarn or Bun. Shaken MCP lets Claude Code and Codex add components for you.

records.name: Takers
records.tagline: Any takers? Fill your golf, padel or 5-a-side game
records.description: Got a tee time or a court and need players? Post it on Takers and your friends grab the open spots. No more chasing in the group chat. Not sure when people are free? Send a date poll and lock the winner into a game with one tap. Works for golf, padel, tennis, five-a-side or anything you play with friends. Free on iPhone and the web.

records.name: Book2Life
records.tagline: The reading app built to get you to the last page
records.description: Most books get started. Fewer get finished. Book2Life is an ebook reader built to fix that: a voice reads along as each word lights up, every character gets a face and every place a picture, and Ask the Book answers only from pages you’ve read. Thousands of free classics, or bring your own EPUBs. On iPhone, iPad, Mac, Android and the web. Try it in your browser with no sign-up.

records.name: lucidml
records.tagline: World models that run on your own GPU
records.description: Move through an open world that a neural network generates frame by frame as you press keys. There is no game engine underneath. I trained it from scratch on my own architecture, Summaryformer, where every frame writes its own memory. Play it in the browser, or download the open weights (Apache-2.0, 630M parameters) from Hugging Face and run it on your own NVIDIA GPU!

records.name: Jessie
records.tagline: Bedtime and everyday stories, written and read aloud
records.description: Jessie is an iPhone app that makes a new audio story and reads it aloud. Tell it what you're in the mood for — a bedtime story, a mystery for the train, a character or a place. It asks a question or two, then writes and narrates the story with music and sound. Listen with the phone locked or with no signal. Kid Mode limits what plays when you hand the phone over. Stories are written and read by AI. Jessie Create is $14.99 a month, Jessie Library is $9.99, both with a 7-day free trial.

records.name: CSS Animation Gallery
records.tagline: 100+ CSS animations you can tune and copy in one click
records.description: Preview 100+ CSS animations plus 3D flip cards, cubes, carousels, sliders and hover effects. Change the speed, easing and loop count on a live element, then copy the HTML and CSS with @keyframes in one click. Every animation is plain CSS with no libraries, so it drops into any site or framework. Free, no sign-up.

records.name: Chiban
records.tagline: Open-source permitting software for small US towns
records.description: Chiban is open-source (AGPL-3.0) land-use and permitting software for small US towns. Building and trade permits at the counter and online, inspections on a phone, planning and zoning board cases with notices to nearby owners, and code enforcement, all filed under the parcel. Each deadline shows the state rule it runs on. Staff edit forms and fees themselves. A complete export is free at any time. Self-host with Docker Compose, or have it hosted.

records.name: Transformer.gg
records.tagline: The agentic influencer marketplace
records.description: The agentic influencer marketplace. Real creators, paid on confirmed posts. Run it from the dashboard or from your agent. Brands send paid offers, creators post on X, and tracked links attribute every click and sale.

records.name: HuntMonitor
records.tagline: Watch today's hunt live: points, speed, rank moves
records.description: HuntMonitor is a live dashboard for today's Product Hunt race. Sort by points, comments, upvote speed, or hunter. Keep one tab open to see if a launch is climbing or slipping. Open any row for the day's points chart. Updates live, snapshots every 15 minutes.

records.name: Skepia
records.tagline: Boost your creativity with daily mental fitness
records.description: Skepia is a design-first mobile app for mental fitness and creative thinking. Take 100+ challenges built on techniques like SCAMPER and lateral thinking, with personalized feedback that reveals your creative profile. And since ideas need a sharp mind, enjoy brain training, reimagined: beautifully crafted puzzles, hard enough to make you think and fun enough to build a daily habit.

records.name: Bookmark Explorer Pro
records.tagline: Find and clean up messy Chrome bookmarks
records.description: Your Chrome bookmarks, finally organized. Bookmark Explorer Pro works with your existing Chrome bookmarks, letting you browse them in a familiar file-explorer interface. Find duplicates, empty folders, and potentially broken links with free health scans. Upgrade to Pro for bulk cleanup, reviewed changes, and undo history. Free bookmark management. $4.99 one-time Lifetime Pro.

records.name: Desk Wars 2: Money Games
records.tagline: Learn banking technicals by playing a banking career
records.description: A game for students recruiting for finance. You play a banking career from analyst up: build merger models and DCFs, price bonds, write credit memos, run trades and manage wealth. Every interview question comes with a worked answer, so you pick up 206 finance concepts as you play. It ends in a Superday with a paper LBO.

records.name: zSign
records.tagline: Send a PDF from a Chrome tab without paying per seat
records.description: zSign gets your agreements signed without per-seat pricing or a subscription. Buy envelopes from $27 for 50, add your team for free, and send from the dashboard, a Chrome tab, Zapier or your AI assistant. Start with 3 free envelopes after email verification.

records.name: Webdesly Estate
records.tagline: Private listings, buyers and viewings for luxury desks
records.description: Quiet listing desk for luxury real-estate agents: off-market properties, verified buyers, and private viewings to confirm or complete on a Today desk. Not a public MLS, not a generic CRM. Free buyer portal and agent desk, no signup.

records.name: TableTop DownTime
records.tagline: Free pixel-art town for your Tabletop party between sessions
records.description: Free to play web app for tabletop RPG groups. (D&D, Pathfinder, Daggerheart) Between sessions your party crafts, visits the tavern, takes quests, plays the casino, keeps pets and gets mail and loot from the GM. GMs build the town and share a code; players join from their devices.

records.name: Tapemoon
records.tagline: Turn your song into a music video, cut to the beat
records.description: Tapemoon is an AI music video generator for songs you own. Upload a WAV/MP3 or paste a Suno link: it maps tempo, sections and lyrics, plans a storyboard you can edit, then renders scenes that cut on the beat. Pick 6 styles (cinematic, anime, cartoon, painting…), 16:9 or 9:16, and video models like Seedance, MiniMax H3 and Kling. Lyrics timed to the vocal, characters can sing. Free storyboard + chorus preview. No real people, no face swaps.

records.name: Pal Again
records.tagline: Your old iPhone or iPad as a gadget for Meta's Muse AI
records.description: Pal Again turns an iPhone or iPad Apple no longer updates into a gadget for Muse, Meta's AI assistant: chat, photos, voice notes, and live voice and video calls with Muse's talking avatar. Built on Meta's open Muse Gadget SDK, open source.

records.name: DealerPing
records.tagline: Reply to every car lead in 5 minutes or less
records.description: Dealers lose car sales to slow lead replies. DealerPing gives your sales team a ready-to-send reply for every new lead, one tap from their own phone. No new software to learn, no texting fees.

records.name: Journzy
records.tagline: Continuity checks that show their evidence
records.description: Journzy is a writing studio for novelists. The story bible tracks characters and places, continuity checks flag conflicts with evidence, and the author writes every word. The AI never writes in the manuscript.

records.name: Tonescrow
records.tagline: Safe escrow deals on TON, no middleman needed
records.description: Tonescrow is an escrow smart contract on TON. The client locks the deal amount, the provider locks a refundable deposit. With both sides having money at stake, scammers are filtered out. The provider gets paid once the work is done and both sides agree. No middleman, no guarantor: just the contract. Deals in GRAM or USDT.

records.name: ArtSync
records.tagline: Post paid creative jobs or get hired as an artist
records.description: ArtSync is a free mobile marketplace for creative work. Clients post a job with a category and paid tag. Artists browse by category, near them, or in the community, save jobs, and message the poster in-app. Artists can also offer their services and set Available for Work on their profile. Every job is tracked from Open to In Progress to Completed.

records.name: Maptake
records.tagline: The AI map animation editor, in your browser or in Claude
records.description: Most map videos on YouTube are keyframed by hand in After Effects. With Maptake you describe the story instead. The AI agent builds it for the scroll: a hook that moves in the first second, text sized for a phone, camera moves over satellite and 3D terrain, routes on real roads. Edit any layer on the timeline, or ask Maptake agent for changes through our MCP server. Export an MP4 for YouTube, TikTok or Reels. Free plan to start.

records.name: Slop Check by NightMarquee
records.tagline: See if your site looks AI-made, and what to change
records.description: Paste a link. The check opens your page in a real browser at desktop and phone width and scores it out of 100. It looks for the patterns that make sites look generated: overused fonts, glows, gradient text, bouncy motion, cards inside cards. Each problem comes with how to fix it, and one prompt holds every fix to paste into Lovable, Bolt, Cursor, Claude or Codex. Free, no account, no email. Publish your result to the public board, or keep it private.

records.name: Disburz
records.tagline: Sell USDT for INR, paid straight to your Indian bank
records.description: Disburz lets you sell USDT (TRC20) and receive INR directly in your Indian bank account by IMPS, NEFT or RTGS. No P2P buyers, so no risk of unknown third-party funds getting your bank account frozen. You see the exact INR before you send, every fee is listed (₹50 + 3 USDT network deduction), and the rate locks when you confirm. Payouts are made by our partner Trans Ramp; you get the UTR by email, and real humans answer support tickets and Telegram.

records.name: Folio Ledger
records.tagline: Track expenses. Review reports. Export your records.
records.description: Folio Ledger is an expense-tracking app for individuals and small businesses. Record income and expenses, organise transactions, monitor spending, and review financial reports in one convenient dashboard. Export your records using CSV, PDF and Excel reporting features. Keep your financial records organised with Folio Ledger.

records.name: Catchline
records.tagline: Bar path and joint angles on your lift video, on-device
records.description: Add a video of your lift and get it back with the bar path, body lines and joint angles drawn on the real footage. Works for snatch, clean and jerk, squat, deadlift, pull-ups and muscle-ups. Step frame by frame, draw your own lines, and export a video with the overlays burned in. Tracking runs on your iPhone: your video never leaves it and is never used for training. Free for 3 videos a week, Pro unlocks unlimited.

records.name: MyGallery: Photo & PDF Scanner
records.tagline: Albums, scanner, hidden vault
records.description: MyGallery makes managing iPhone photos and documents simple. Automatically organize camera photos, screenshots and downloads into albums. Find similar photos, search by faces or objects, and protect private memories with a discreet Face ID hidden album. Scan, edit, merge and sign PDFs—all in one app, with on-device photo processing and no unnecessary complexity. Free to download, with a 14-day trial and an optional $5.99 lifetime Pro purchase in the US. No subscription.

records.name: MCP Cursor Guard
records.tagline: The paging bug in your MCP server, fixed with signed cursors
records.description: MCP pagination fails silently when an agent replays an offset cursor against different filters. Signed, expiring filter-bound cursors fix it: mismatch throws invalid_cursor. Free MIT library on npm plus runnable demo. The kit adds auth, rate limiting, HTTP transport and tests — one payment.

records.name: YoFluent
records.tagline: Speak English out loud with an AI tutor, get real feedback
records.description: Practise speaking English in voice calls with friendly AI tutors: job interviews, small talk, IELTS and 13 more real situations. When you hang up, see every mistake fixed, every sound scored and your CEFR level. Your first call is free.

records.name: Morse Code Translator
records.tagline: Translate and decode Morse code — even from audio
records.description: Type text or dots and dashes and see the other side update live. Play it as sound, light or vibration, and download a WAV. Upload a recording or use your mic to decode Morse audio. No signup; everything runs in your browser.

records.name: hisabkaroo
records.tagline: Free GST billing, accounting & payroll for Indian business
records.description: Hisabkaroo is a free GST billing, accounting, and payroll software built for Indian businesses. It offers GST-compliant invoicing, inventory management, HSN code finder, GST calculator, and comprehensive accounting tools. Designed for Indian MSMEs, freelancers, and small businesses, Hisabkaroo simplifies GST compliance with automated tax calculations, e-invoicing support, and real-time financial reporting.

records.name: Xeek Sites
records.tagline: Design websites with AI, then refine every detail
records.description: Describe the website you want and Xeek Sites drafts it, ready for you to change and publish.

records.name: LuxeChain AI
records.tagline: One API Key. Multiple AI Models.
records.description: One API key and one prepaid balance for Claude, GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek and every other model we carry — 83 in all, across chat, images, video and voice. Paid in rupees, from an Indian account.

records.name: SchoolManagementGH
records.tagline: School management software built for Ghanaian schools.
records.description: SchoolManagementGH helps schools in Ghana simplify daily administration from one platform. Manage student and staff records, attendance, school fees, examinations, results, report cards and parent communication in one centralized system.

records.name: MaxBot
records.tagline: Twitch roles in Discord, an economy and overlays, hosted
records.description: MaxBot pushes your Twitch subs, VIPs and mods into Discord roles the moment they change, and takes the role off when a sub lapses. It also runs a watch-time economy with 15 games that work in Twitch chat and Discord, automod, custom commands, timed messages and stream overlays you lay out in a visual editor. It's hosted, so it keeps running when your PC is off, and one account runs every channel you're part of. Free to start; paid tiers from $5 a month.
